DIAGNOSIS READY: Endometrial Hyperplasia with concurrent Ovarian Tumor.

The ultrasound findings of a thickened endometrial stripe in a postmenopausal woman strongly suggest endometrial hyperplasia, often driven by unopposed estrogen. The concurrent left adnexal mass requires further characterization to determine if it is an ovarian cyst, tumor, or endometrioma. Given these findings, we must urgently rule out endometrial cancer and assess the nature of the ovarian mass. I will now request histopathology if you have had a biopsy, and I need to know if you have any bleeding disorders or are currently on Tamoxifen therapy. If no biopsy is available, I recommend a biopsy of the endometrium and tumor markers like CA-125 and HE4.
